title: MELTS: Attack Path Link Drilldown
description: Link analysis for the 2025-2026 campaign. Groups trace IDs to log sources and stages so analysts can pivot from entry point to host execution, cloud abuse, C2, exfiltration, and the MELTS signal class behind the evidence.
query: ('Trace ID' = 'trace_clickfix_2026_001' or 'Trace ID' = 'trace_toolshell_sp_001' or 'Trace ID' = 'trace_rmm_2025_001' or 'Trace ID' = 'trace_aitm_token_2026_001' or 'Threat Name' = 'ClickFix Clipboard Execution' or 'Threat Name' = 'CrashFix Python RAT' or 'Threat Name' = 'RMM Tool Abuse' or 'Threat Name' = 'AiTM Token Replay' or 'Request URL' like '*spinstall0.aspx*' or 'Command Line' like '*ClickFix*' or 'Command Line' like '*CrashFix*' or 'Process Name' like '*ScreenConnect*' or 'Process Name' like '*AnyDesk*' or 'Process Name' like '*AteraAgent*' or 'User Name' = 'codeofconduct-reader@corp.example.com') | link span = 15minute 'Trace ID', 'Log Source', 'Attack Stage' | eventstats max(Count) as PeakEvents, sum(Count) as Events, distinctcount('Trace ID') as Traces, distinctcount('Log Source') as Sources, distinctcount('Attack Stage') as Stages

visualizationOptions.tileLayoutXml: <title-text>Peak Path</title-text><title-text>Evidence</title-text><title-text>Traces</title-text><title-text>Sources</title-text><title-text>Stages</title-text><title-text>Trace Workflow</title-text><title-text>Drilldown</title-text><title-text>Next Pivot</title-text><title-text>Identity</title-text><title-text>Endpoint</title-text><title-text>Network</title-text><title-text>Evidence</title-text>

ask_ai_prompts: Trace each attack path from entry point to exfiltration.
Identify missing telemetry for any trace group.
